title: refactor(fields): retire the dead SchemaRendererContext record tail (objectui#7206)
body:
Fixes #7206

`Clause-②: no` — set by the ruling itself: 「no published type moves; `LookupField` / `useCascadingOptions` lose a fallback that **never fired**」.

## The ruling this implements

Maintainer ruling on this card (record `5729479695`, 2026-09-18T11:42Z, 「同意」), letter **C**. Retire the dead tail under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; rewrite the comments that describe it as a live 「record scope」 channel; ⛔ add no `data` / `formValues` member to `@object-ui/react`'s context (option B, refused by name); ⛔ build no lint-shaped guard, because the next host that forgets should fail visibly.

## What landed

**The reads (`@object-ui/fields`).** `LookupField`'s `resolvedDependentValues` and `useCascadingOptions`' `record` both resolved `dependentValues ?? ctx.formValues ?? ctx.data ?? {}`. Both now resolve `dependentValues ?? {}`. `LookupField`'s deliberately widened context view — the cast that let the two undeclared members type-check at all — is deleted with them; `useCascadingOptions` no longer reads `SchemaRendererContext` at all and drops the import.

**The prose.** The three sites the ruling names (the `LookupField` resolver docblock, the `dependentValues` bullet in `toHostProps.ts`, the supply-half comment in app-shell's `ActionParamDialog.tsx`) now say the host supplies the record and there is no context fallback. Four more sites quoted the chain in the present tense and this diff makes each of them false, so they move with it: the `dependentValues` prop doc in `fields`' widget `types.ts` (the self-referential one — the doc of the only working channel pointing at the one that never existed), the injection note in `@object-ui/components`' form renderer, and the two grid sites (`ObjectGrid`'s cell-editor seam, `BulkActionDialog`'s supply half). Seven test docblocks that restate the chain are corrected the same way. ⛔ No `CHANGELOG` is touched.

**The pin.** `LookupField.contextTailRetired-7206.test.tsx` makes the retirement observable, which no existing test could be: no host can set those members, so nothing in production moves and the whole suite is green either way. Each subject renders the cast the deleted reads needed — a context value carrying `formValues` AND `data` — and asserts the widget ignores it, each paired with a live control moving the same record onto `dependentValues`. The pins are keyed on the READ: both widgets' comments still NAME `ctx.formValues` / `ctx.data` in order to say they are gone, so a source-text assertion on those spellings would pass with the reads restored.

## ⛔ Deliberately NOT in this PR

- **The hosts.** The grid's cell-editor seam (objectui#7165) and the detail page / `InlineFieldInput` call sites (objectui#7190) are the landing sites, and the ruling says so; this card is the root. Neither of those two is addressed here, and both stay open.
- **A guard.** No lint rule, no dev warning, no console line for a host that passes no `dependentValues`. A helpful warning here re-creates the hidden failure that option C exists to remove.
- **The context contract.** Nothing is added to `SchemaRendererContextType`.

## Measurements

**Provider census, re-derived rather than copied** (this card's body says ONE non-test provider; comment `5493538036` corrects that to FOUR, and the correction is the right number). `SchemaRendererContext.Provider` outside tests: **four** providers — `SchemaRendererProvider` itself, plus `apps/site`'s `InteractiveDemo`, `LiveSplitDemo` and `SchemaThumbnail` — against a live control of the same instrument including tests, which fires on 114 lines. Read at the value objects rather than at the tags: the provider passes `{ dataSource, debug, debugFlags, apiFetch }` and all three `apps/site` surfaces pass a `defaultCtx` of `{ dataSource }` alone. ⇒ the tail was unsettable, and nothing observable moves.

**Ablation, both directions, from the committed tree**, through `ablation-replace` so the mutation's arrival on disk is the tool's verdict and not a memory of mine (anchor hit counts and before/after blob hashes on every leg). Restoring both tails turns the new pin **red** — the `LookupField` gating subject, the `useCascadingOptions` gating subject, and the rewritten app-shell case — while the rest of those two files stays green. The restore leg is proven by blob equality with `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`, and the retired state is green again afterwards.

⚠️ One case did NOT redden under ablation: the `dependentValues` precedence case, because a supplied prop won that chain outright even with the tail restored. Its comment claimed it was the retirement's second half; it now says what it actually pins. Recorded rather than quietly dropped — a case asserting an ablation it does not have is this card's own defect one level up.

**Gates and suites** (all from the repo root, per AGENTS.md §怎么跑测试):

- `@object-ui/fields`, whole package: 167 files / 2875 tests pass.
- The consumer files this diff touches, plus the two source-text tests that read `LookupField.tsx` (`relationalMetaCopySet.derivation`, `field-metadata-depends-on-declared-6153`): 10 files / 63 tests pass.
- `turbo run type-check` over `fields`, `app-shell`, `components`, `plugin-grid` and their dependency closure: 33/33 tasks successful. The new test file is covered by the `tsconfig.test.json` leg of `fields`' `type-check` — measured with `--listFiles`, with an existing sibling test as the control.
- `check:changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`, `changeset:check`: all exit 0.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 17 touched files and declared as a narrowing: 0 errors, exit 0. The narrowing is defensible because this config enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict of a file it does not touch. The file count is eslint's own, read out of `--format json`. The repo-wide run stays CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **`.changeset/7165-grid-dependent-values.md` goes stale on merge, and `check:changeset-claims` cannot see it.** Its body states `LookupField` resolves the record "as `dependentValues ?? ctx.formValues ?? ctx.data ?? {}`", which this diff makes false, and that body publishes verbatim into the `CHANGELOG` at the next release. The gate did not report it because it matches claims by backticked FILE name and that sentence names symbols only — so this is a human hand-off, not a gap in my run. ⛔ Not edited here: it is another card's release declaration, and `check-changeset-overwrite` exists to keep a change out of a pending changeset it does not own. Noted, not filed.
- **`.changeset/7206-dead-context-tail-comments.md`** (this card's earlier comment slice) stays accurate about its own diff, including its closing line that the retire-or-make-real question was open at the time. It will publish in the same release as this one. Noted, not filed.
- **Why the false comments were plausible**, worth one line for the next reader: a `ctx.data` really does exist one hop away, on `useRecordContext()`, which `plugin-detail` reads for exactly the record scope these comments claimed. The dead channel was the RIGHT idea pointed at the WRONG context. Noted, not filed.
- ⛔ Nothing here needs a new card: no reproducible defect, no contract violated, no trap that makes an AI author metadata a runtime refuses.
